errors.text: The required 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell boundary is replaced by an unsupported estimate of greater than 100 atoms, which is inadequate as a reconstruction of the finite-size condition.

The hypothesis implies that the MTP itself reproduces electronic DOS-gap effects; these electronic free-energy contributions generally require finite-temperature DFT or a separate correction rather than ordinary configurational MTP sampling.
The cited evidence does not substantiate the central quantitative claims about MTP-FEP accuracy, 80% savings, the 0.5 meV/atom agreement threshold, or the 2.4 meV/atom SRO stabilization.
